read_by: automated retrieval reviewed in session, 18 September 2026; no practitioner review
notes: The live discovery response spells calculators urn:sbrm:calculator:..., while publish.html documents urn:sbrm:calc:.... The live spelling is recorded here because it is what the routes accept.

Request money fields are declared type: number in the live OpenAPI, not decimal strings. Requests therefore carry JSON numbers, serialised exactly by lodgeitadapter.decimals rather than through float.

Response 200 bodies are declared as objects with additionalProperties: true and no response schema, so the fields below were read from llms.txt and from the shape of live responses, not from a schema.
GET /healthz returned 404 on 18 September 2026 while GET /livez returned 200, although both are declared.

Only the three calculators this repository has a local counterpart for are recorded. The nineteen FBT benefit categories are listed by the provider; one is recorded here because one is what has been reviewed.
This snapshot is a reading, not an agreement. Nothing in it is endorsed by LodgeiT Labs.

Decimal fields are split into required and optional. A required field's absence is a contract failure; an optional field appears only in some outcomes, such as a Division 7A deemed dividend where nothing fell short.

Read from a live div7a response on 18 September 2026: the advisory block carries `disclaimer`, not the `notes` array llms.txt and publish.html describe, and the body also echoes `amalgamated_base`, `period_uri` and `rate_uris_consumed`. The manifest entries use `content_hash`, not the `sha256` key the publishing standard's example shows. advisory_any_of records which keys count as an advisory; a response with neither is still a contract failure.

Live 200 bodies carry more than the standard describes. Depreciation adds `numeric_mode`. The FBT car statutory formula adds counts_towards_fbt_cap, exempt_under, exemption_provenance, gross_taxable_value, rfba_notional_grossed_up_t2, rfba_notional_taxable_value, s8a_inputs and taxable_value_before_reductions. Recorded on 18 September 2026 so they read as known rather than as drift; none is consumed.

urn:sbrm:calculator:div7a:at.label: Division 7A minimum yearly repayment
scope_notes: The provider derives the remaining term from loan_term_years, loan_origination_date and income_year_start_date, with is_first_real_myr_year as an override. The local engine takes the remaining term as an operator assertion and applies the s 109E(6) rounding to it.

The provider returns is_complying and deemed_dividend. Those are the provider's labels for its own arithmetic. They are not a Division 7A determination and must not be mapped onto the local engine's gate verdicts.

Live on 18 September 2026 this route returned statutory_myr 21874.92, shortfall 0.00, total_repayments 22000.00 and benchmark_rate 0.0837 for the fabricated loan in fixtures/example-div7a-request.json, agreeing to the cent with both the local engine and the s 109E(6) formula evaluated independently.

urn:sbrm:calculator:depreciation:at.label: AASB 116 carrying amount at a date
scope_notes: Accounting basis only. This is not a Division 40 deduction and the tax figure will not equal it.
basis accepts only the literal "accounting"; a pooled asset returns 400 pool_asset_out_of_t6_scope.

urn:sbrm:calculator:depreciation:range.label: AASB 116 depreciation over a range
scope_notes: day_count is required on this route and has no default.

Documented limitation, as published on 18 September 2026: where from_date precedes acquisition_date the cost enters during the window and no cost_additions field is emitted, so closing_wdv = opening_wdv - range_dep does not hold. The provider says range_dep and closing_wdv are correct and the roll-forward is not closable from the response alone.

Live on 18 September 2026: a window on or after the acquisition date closes exactly (120000.00 opening, 24000.00 charge, 96000.00 closing for a five-year prime-cost asset over its first anniversary year), consecutive windows telescope (12098.63 + 11901.37 = 24000.00 and the closing of one is the opening of the next), and a window starting before the acquisition date reproduces the published limitation: opening 0.00, closing 107901.37, charge 12098.63 and a 120000.00 gap with no cost_additions field.

urn:sbrm:calculator:fbt:car-statutory-fo.label: FBT car, statutory formula method
scope_notes: taxable_value is the category taxable value. grossed_up_taxable_value and fbt_payable are derived from it and must never be grossed up again.

fbtType selects the gross-up rate and defaults engine-side to Type 2 when omitted. Type 1 and type 2 classification is a professional judgement about creditable acquisitions, which this adapter requires the caller to establish rather than inheriting the default.

Live on 18 September 2026: a 40000.00 base value available all year with no accessories or employee contribution returned taxable_value 8000.00, grossed_up_taxable_value 15094.40 and fbt_payable 7094.37. Carrying only the category taxable value into austaxcalc.fbt as a Type 2 amount produced the same 15094.40 and 7094.37.
